newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chairman buys shares in Pearl Oriental.
newsitem.headline: Chairman buys shares in Pearl Oriental.

text.p: Pearl Oriental Holdings Ltd said its chairman and chief executive, Wong Kwan, acquired on Tuesday 39 million shares of the company from the market for HK$3.50 each, or a total HK$136.5 million.
The acquisition raised his sharholding in the group to about three billion shares, estimated to be about 64.7 percent of the group's total issued share captial, Pearl Oriental said in a statement.
It did not give his original interest in the company.
Wong said in the statement his shareholding would be held for long term investment purposes.
